name: City Council Meeting
minutes_text:
MISSION VIEJO MINUTES
  City Council, Community Development Agency,
  Community Development Financing Authority,
  Public Improvement Corporation,
  and Library Board of Trustees*

  November 15, 2010

A Regular Meeting of the City Council, the Community Development Agency, the Community
Development Financing Authority, the Public Improvement Corporation, and the Library Board
of Trustees of the City of Mission Viejo, California, was called to order by Mayor Kelley at 5:07
p.m., on November 15, 2010, at 200 Civic Center, Mission Viejo, California.

A complete copy of the agenda for the meeting containing all items as shown herein was posted
by 5:00 p.m. on November 12, 2010, on the outdoor bulletin board at City Hall. Copies were also
posted at the Montanoso Recreation and Fitness Center, 25800 Montanoso Drive, and the
Norman P. Murray Community and Senior Center, 24932 Veterans Way.

*All Board and Agency memberships are reflected in the title "Council Member."

Present:  Council Member Ledesma
  Council Member Schlicht (arrived at 5:10 p.m.)
  Council Member Ury
  Mayor Pro Tem Leckness
  Mayor Kelley

Absent:  None

Staff Present:  Dennis Wilberg, City Manager
  Irwin B. Bornstein, Assistant City Manager/Director of Admin. Services
  William P. Curley III, City Attorney
  Karen Hamman, City Clerk

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE: Mayor Kelley

INVOCATION: Council Member Ledesma

RECESS

At the hour of 5:09 p.m., Mayor Kelley declared a recess. The City Council reconvened at 6:03
p.m. with all five City Council Members present.

City Council Minutes  1  November 15, 2010
 PRESENTATIONS

P1.  Recognize the 50th Anniversary of Moulton Niguel Water District

  Mayor Kelley presented the proclamation to Director Richard Fiore, Moulton Niguel
  Water District.

P2.  Presentation by the Orange County Transportation Authority (OCTA) on the
  Proposed Avery/I-5 Interchange Improvement Alternatives

  Tamara S. Warren, Corridor Studies Project Manager, presented the report.

P3.  Presentation by the County on the Status of the Environmental Efforts for the La
  Pata Avenue Gap Closure and Del Rio Extension Project

  Les Card from LSA presented the status report on behalf of the County.

PUBLIC COMMENTS

There were no public comments.

CONSENT CALENDAR

Items 9, 12, 13, 18 and 21 were removed from the Consent Calendar for separate discussion.

Motion made by Council Member Ury, seconded by Council Member Ledesma, to approve the
Consent Calendar as described below.

On roll call, said motion carried by the following vote:

AYES:  Kelley, Leckness, Ledesma, Schlicht and Ury
NOES:  None
ABSENT:  None

1.  Waive Reading of Ordinances and Resolutions

  Approved the reading by title of all ordinances and resolutions and declared that said
  titles which appear on the public agenda shall be determined to have been read by title
  and further reading waived.

2.  City Council Minutes

  Approved the Minutes for the regular City Council Meeting of November 1, 2010, as
  presented.

City Council Minutes  2  November 15, 2010
 3.  Check Register dated October 22, 2010, in the amount of $2,831,576.55

  Ratified the accompanying check register.

4.  Check Register dated October 29, 2010, in the amount of $838,814.90

  Ratified the accompanying check register.

5.  Quarterly Check Registers and Quarterly Cash Receipts Report - First Quarter of
  FY 2010-11

  Received and filed.

6.  City Treasurer’s Monthly Report for September 2010

  Received and filed.

7.  Community Development Agency (CDA) Treasurer’s Monthly Report for
  September 2010

  Received and filed.

8.  Mission Viejo Community Development Financing Authority (MVCDFA)
  Treasurer’s Monthly Report for September 2010

  Received and filed.

10.  Quarterly Financial Report for the Community Development Agency (CDA) - First
  Quarter of 2010-11

  Received and filed.

11.  Dissolution of the Mission Viejo Public Improvement Corporation

  Authorized execution of the State of California Domestic Nonprofit Corporation
  Certificate of Dissolution.

14.  Fiber Communication and Traffic Controller Upgrade Project-Various Locations
  (CIP 797)

  (1) Approved the bid specifications and authorized staff to advertise for construction bids
  for the subject project; (2) approved the contract in the amount of $206,044.10 to
  Econolite Control Products, Inc., for Centracs Licensing for up to 100 traffic signals and
  for the installation of 80 traffic signal controllers.

City Council Minutes  3  November 15, 2010
 15.  Montanoso Drive Neighborhood Traffic Management Program, Phase 2 (CIP 779-
  Traffic Safety Program)

  Approved the bid specifications for Phase 2 and authorized staff to advertise for
  construction bids for the subject project.

16.  Notice of Completion for Oso Creek Restoration and Protection Project (CIP 207)-
  Montanoso Recreation Center Bioswale

  (1) Certified the completion of and accepted the improvements for the subject project; (2)
  authorized the City Manager to sign the Notice of Completion; (3) authorized the City
  Clerk to record the Notice of Completion with the County of Orange and to release the
  faithful performance and payment bonds one year and 35 days, respectively, after the
  date of recordation of the Notice of Completion contingent upon no claims or liens being
  filed with the City; and (4) authorized payment of the final retention 35 days after the
  date of recordation of the Notice of Completion.

17.  Community Services Funding Program - Funding for Fiscal Year 2010-2011

  Approved the Community Services Commission’s recommended funding amounts for
  Fiscal Year 2010-2011 for the Community Services Funding Program.

19.  City of Mission Viejo Corporation Yard - Extend Lease Agreement with Santa
  Margarita Water District

  Approved the Fourth Amendment to the existing Lease Agreement with the Santa
  Margarita Water District.

20.  Marguerite Parkway Pavement Rehabilitation, Avery Parkway to Crown Valley
  Parkway (CIP 788)

  (1) Certified the completion of and accepted the improvements for the subject project; (2)
  authorized the City Manager to sign the Notice of Completion; (3) authorized the City
  Clerk to record the Notice of Completion with the County of Orange and to release the
  faithful performance and payment bonds one year and 35 days, respectively, after the
  date of recordation of the Notice of Completion contingent upon no claims or liens being
  filed with the City; (4) authorized payment of 50% of Excel Paving Company’s
  construction contract retention in the amount of $39,190.72; and (5) authorized payment
  of the final retention 35 days after the date of recordation of the Notice of Completion.

PUBLIC HEARINGS

OLD BUSINESS

NEW BUSINESS

City Council Minutes  4  November 15, 2010
 22.  Ordinance Relating to Water Quality

  City Engineer Richard Schlesinger presented the staff report and answered Council
  Member Schlicht’s questions regarding enforcement, illicit connections, entry to inspect,
  potential violators, and the effect on pool owners.

  Motion made by Council Member Ury, seconded by Mayor Pro Tem Leckness, to
  introduce Ordinance 10-285 Amending the Municipal Code by Amending Chapter 6.65
  of Title 6 Relating to Water Quality.

  On roll call, said motion carried by the following vote:

  AYES:  Kelley, Leckness, Ledesma, Schlicht, and Ury
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT: None

23.  Ordinance Related to Grading and Excavations

  City Engineer Richard Schlesinger presented the staff report.

  Motion made by Council Member Ledesma, seconded by Mayor Pro Tem Leckness, to
  (1) introduce Ordinance 10-286 Amending the Municipal Code by Repealing Chapter
  8.10 of Title 8 and Adding a New Chapter 8.10 Relating to Grading and Excavations; and
  (2) adopt Resolution 10-59 Adopting Changes to the Grading Manual and Authorizing
  the Director of Public Works to Incorporate Further Amendments into the Grading
  Manual as may be Necessary to Administer the Grading Code Consistent with Ordinance
  10-286.

  On roll call, said motion carried by the following vote:

  AYES:  Kelley, Leckness, Ledesma, Schlicht, and Ury
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT: None

ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR

9.  Quarterly Financial Report for the City of Mission Viejo - First Quarter of 2010-11

  Assistant City Manager/Director of Administrative Services Irwin Bornstein presented
  the staff report and answered Council Member Schlicht’s questions regarding special
  revenue funds with deficit fund balances, personnel costs, and the funds that make up the
  contingency reserve.

City Council Minutes  5  November 15, 2010
   Motion made by Council Member Schlicht, seconded by Council Member Ury, to receive
  and file the report.

  On roll call, said motion carried by the following vote:

  AYES:  Kelley, Leckness, Ledesma, Schlicht, and Ury
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT: None

12.  City Manager’s Credit Card Authority

  Assistant City Manager/Director of Administrative Services Irwin Bornstein presented
  the staff report.

  Council Member Schlicht asked questions of staff and expressed her opposition to use of
  the credit card.

  Motion made by Council Member Ury, seconded by Mayor Pro Tem Leckness, to adopt
  Resolution 10-57 Authorizing the Use of the City Manager’s Corporate Credit Card for
  All Business-Related Conference Expenditures Incurred by Members of the City Council
  and the City Manager.

  On roll call, said motion carried by the following vote:

  AYES:  Kelley, Leckness, Ledesma, and Ury
  NOES:  Schlicht
  ABSENT: None

13.  Request by the Southern California Association of Governments (SCAG) for
  Support of "Business Friendly Principles" as part of SCAG’s Development of a
  Southern California Economic Growth Strategy

  Director of Community Development Chuck Wilson presented the staff report.

  Council Member Schlicht read email correspondence from a commercial real estate
  broker which demonstrates that the City of Mission Viejo is already business friendly.

  Motion made by Mayor Pro Tem Leckness, seconded by Council Member Ledesma, to
  adopt Resolution 10-58 In Support of “Business Friendly Principles” As Part of SCAG’s
  Development of a Southern California Economic Growth Strategy.

  On roll call, said motion carried by the following vote:

City Council Minutes  6  November 15, 2010
   AYES:  Kelley, Leckness, Ledesma, Schlicht, and Ury
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT: None

18.  Marguerite Tennis Center Renovation Project (CIP 501)

  Director of Recreation and Community Services Kelly Doyle presented the staff report.

  The following expressed support for the Tennis Center renovation and for the proposal to
  rebid the project: Kime Goodrum, M.V.; Wil Garcia, M.V.; Tom Teichmann, M.V.

  The following presented written comments in support of the project: Shripathi Kamath.

  Larry Ryan, RJM Design: answered questions of the City Council and stated that he
  supports the recommendation to reject the bids due to the irregularities that were
  discovered.

  Motion made by Council Member Ury, seconded by Mayor Pro Tem Leckness, to (1)
  reject all bids for the project; (2) approve the contract bid documents; (3) authorize staff
  to re-advertise for bids for the Marguerite Tennis Center Renovation Project; and (4)
  approve Change Order No. 2 to RJM Design Group in the amount of $29,875.

  On roll call, said motion carried by the following vote:

  AYES:  Kelley, Leckness, Ledesma, and Ury
  NOES:  Schlicht
  ABSENT: None

  Council Member Schlicht announced that she wanted the motion to be bifurcated so she
  could have voted in favor of the first three recommendations and in opposition to
  recommendation number 4, the RJM change order.

21.  Mission Viejo Library Friends Community Room Remodel (CIP 601)

  Director of Library Services Valerie Maginnis presented the staff report and answered the
  City Council Member’s questions.

  City Manager Wilberg discussed contract negotiations and stated that quite often, staff
  works to get a better price before the contract ever comes to the City Council for
  approval. He reminded the Council Members to ask staff if they have questions or need
  further information about contract negotiations or discounts received.

  Motion made by Council Member Schlicht, seconded by Mayor Pro Tem Leckness, to
  approve a contract with Robert R. Coffee, Architect + Associates in an amount not to

City Council Minutes  7  November 15, 2010
   exceed $61,600 for planning and design for the remodel of the Mission Viejo Library
  Friends Community Room.

  On roll call, said motion carried by the following vote:

  AYES:  Kelley, Leckness, Ledesma, Schlicht, and Ury
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT: None

MAYOR’S, COMMISSION, AND COMMITTEE REPORTS

24.  Orange County Fire Authority (OCFA) Report

  Mayor Kelley presented the report.

25.  Foothill/Eastern Transportation Corridor Agency Report

  Mayor Kelley presented the report.

26.  San Joaquin Hills Transportation Corridor Agency Report

  Mayor Kelley presented the report.

27.  SCAG Transportation & Communications Committee (TCC) Report

  Mayor Kelley presented the report.

STAFF REPORTS

City Manager’s Report

City Manager Wilberg advised the City Council that he will be out of town for a week beginning
Thursday, November 18, 2010.

City Attorney's Report

COUNCIL MEMBER COMMENTS AND ACTIONS

28.  Council Member Reports of Events and Activities Attended

  The City Council Members acknowledged their event and activities calendars as
  presented in the report and agreed to provide any changes to the City Clerk for the public
  record.

City Council Minutes  8  November 15, 2010
 Council Member Ledesma

Council Member Ledesma wished everyone a happy Thanksgiving.

Council Member Schlicht

Council Member Schlicht announced that it was her pleasure to participate in the city’s Veteran’s
Day ceremony in honor of our country’s heroes. She and Council Member-Elect Rhonda
Reardon also attended The Chabad of Mission Viejo Points of Light celebration where eight
families were recognized for changing the lives of the unfortunate. She congratulated the
Mission Viejo Diablos football team and she commended the Trabuco Hills High School
Mustangs for playing a strong game against the Diablos. During the game, The Mustangs
exemplified their motto of dedication, determination and desire. Council Member Schlicht
congratulated resident Brad Morton on the third anniversary of the Mission Viejo Dispatch and
she encouraged residents to visit the blog. Finally, she wished everyone a happy Thanksgiving.

Council Member Ury

29.  Proposed Association of California Cities—Orange County

  Council Member Ury presented his report.

  Motion made by Council Member Ury, seconded by Mayor Pro Tem Leckness, to
  approve the City of Mission Viejo joining and paying dues to the Association of
  California Cities—Orange County once the organization is formed.

  On roll call, said motion carried by the following vote:

  AYES:  Kelley, Leckness, Ledesma, Schlicht, and Ury
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT: None

Council Member Ury commented on the Veteran’s Day ceremony and he wished everyone a
wonderful Thanksgiving.

Mayor Pro Tem Leckness

Mayor Pro Tem Leckness discussed his attendance at a recent Elk's Lodge event where about
half a dozen WWII Veterans were honored. The slide show presentation was very moving and it
was truly great to hear the veterans’ stories.

Mayor Kelley

Mayor Kelley congratulated Mayor Pro Tem Leckness on his re-election and Rhonda Reardon
on her election to the Mission Viejo City Council. She also commented on the Veteran’s Day

City Council Minutes  9  November 15, 2010
 ceremony which was the largest in the city’s history with between 500 and 600 attendees. It was
a great tribute to those who serve our nation and she was pleased to honor resident and veteran
Snuffy Brown with the home town hero award. She thanked all those who attended and
reiterated her thanks to our country’s veterans. Mayor Kelley announced that Kids Factory will
be offered during the Thanksgiving school recess. The program is free for those who are
registered or residents can pay the $25 registration fee so their children are eligible to attend
during the holiday break. She also highlighted the recent good news about the city’s sales tax
performance which was up 10.10% or approximately $328,000 compared to the second quarter
of 2009. Mission Viejo preformed better than Orange County in total, the State of California,
and six of the other eleven south Orange County cities. Mayor Kelley reminded residents to
mark their calendars for Santa’s arrival on Sunday, November 28, 2010. The celebration will be
held in the civic center parking lot and begins at 3:00 p.m. There will be festival booths,
entertainment at 5:00 and Santa will arrive on the fire truck at 6:00 p.m. She also announced that
Santa will be in his workshop every Wednesday, Saturday and Sunday from December 1 to 19,
2010, between the hours of 6:00 and 8:00 p.m.

ADJOURNMENT

At the hour of 8:37 p.m., with no further business to come before the City Council at this session,
Mayor Kelley adjourned the meeting in memory of William Barker to Monday, December 6,
2010, at 5:00 p.m.

__________________________________________
Karen Hamman, City Clerk

Approved at the meeting of December 6, 2010

City Council Minutes  10  November 15, 2010
